rasterTechnique: Authored raster scenes; visual and gameplay approval tracked separately.

moves.name: clay-hook
moves.sequence: A compact earthen forearm curls low, drives one upward clay hook, spatters wet clay at contact, hardens those spatters into layered defensive cuffs, then lowers. Detailed sculpted clay hand; no whole character.

moves.name: featherweight
moves.sequence: Three delicate feather-tipped talon quills flex and sweep together in one weightless claw rake; three curved trails converge at ONE contact, white barbs drift away and tips uncurl. No full bird.

moves.name: iron-strike
moves.sequence: A broad blunt riveted steel striker on a short articulated shank draws back, strikes one downward diagonal with flat weighted contact, chips scatter, then rebounds and retracts. No sharpened sword or fist.
